explanation: From main: The router runs one navigation attempt at a time. begin(policy) retires the attempt in flight, clears routePending and routeError and sets the write policy: replace for a followed URL, push for a user action, hold after an ignored fragment until the target hash changes; the write effect consumes it on a write, a matching hash or a refusal. hasWritten, the replaceNextWrite stop-gap and the retired-landing replaceState are gone. Verbs and view-reported setters (on a real change only) start push attempts, openInExplorer(id, track) verifies through landRoute and settleExplorer, and App calls the new stable supersede() before its track, tab, contrast, leave-Compare and send-genes navigate calls. From this branch: App holds the survey-to-gene-page handoff in memory: ExpressionSurveyView calls onOpenGene(symbol, scope), App stores { gene, scope } and opens the gene report through searchGene, and passes the scope to that gene's report only. Routes and appRouter are unchanged; #/expression and #/gene/<symbol> keep their forms.
